attributes.name: TeamSpeak 3 Server
attributes.description: Download server files from https://teamspeak.com/en/downloads/#server (Server amd64 Linux -> tar.bz2) via Files > Download from URL. Self-extracts on first boot; grab the privileged keys from console log.
attributes.startup: [ -x ts3server ] || (tar xjf {{ARCHIVE}} --strip-components=1 && chmod +x ts3server); ./ts3server license_accepted=1 default_voice_port={{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# TeamSpeak 3 install script. Server files: /mnt/server
apt-get update -qq; apt-get install -yqq curl bzip2 ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "$TS3_VERSION" ]; then
    TS3_VERSION=3.13.7
fi
URL="https://files.teamspeak-services.com/releases/server/${TS3_VERSION}/teamspeak3-server_linux_amd64-${TS3_VERSION}.tar.bz2"
echo "downloading TeamSpeak3 server ${TS3_VERSION}"
curl -fsSLo ts3.tar.bz2 "$URL" || { echo "download failed: ${URL}"; exit 1; }
tar xjf ts3.tar.bz2 --strip-components=1
rm -f ts3.tar.bz2
chmod +x ts3server
echo "TeamSpeak3 installed"
